areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Objectives, components and products directly tied; SMART indicators; most resources go to the area; high impact; efficient solutions (regionalisation, facility modernisation, ICT-based services, new general hospital).

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Objectives and components related, SMART indicators; part of resources; limited impact; actions strengthen regional network coordination and add a hospital in a region of high regional dependence.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Relevant general objective and related component, but indicators weakly representative; small resource share and low impact; workshops, consulting and training for network managers.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: General objective contributes only indirectly; specific objective, component and SMART indicators exist; resource share not relevant; moderate impact; ICT-based care models and telehealth.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: No objectives or indicators directly related; minimum criteria not met.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Facility modernisation touches climate resilience, but no objectives or indicators directly related; minimum criteria not met.

bonus.reason: Resources are entirely directed to strengthening primary and specialised health care, a federal priority, through governance, facility modernisation, ICT and a new hospital.
Proponent did not indicate regional integration; the NT gives no separate section for this bonus.
